text:
tess: FYI team — planning a config-only change tonight at 01:30 UTC. scope: prod global with staged roll. changes: default_concurrency_per_worker 64 -> 48, global_tenant_floor 100r/s -> 80r/s, batch_threshold_ms 25 -> 12, request_timeout_ms 10000 -> 8000. routing policy will be pinned to 'latency-first' for rollout window. canary in us-east1 for 15m.

omar: what's the exact rollback play? thresholds?

tess: rollback if p95 increases >30% or p99 >25% or 5xx rate >0.3% sustained for 10m. also rollback if any single-host kvcache evict/sec >200.

devops-anya: adding CI smoke: redwoodctl preview-config --env prod --file night-config.json and synthetic probe for heavy routes. I'll wire alerts to pager after canary.

release-bot: [scheduled] config-only change scheduled by tess -> canary(us-east1) at 1737010200, tag cfg-2026-04-03-001

sre-sam: recommend setting a short TTL warmup on canary instances: kvcache_warm_ms=8000 for first 4m to reduce cold eviction churn.

product-ryan: any customers with pinned rate caps? call out marketplace tenants that have explicit overrides so we don't surprise them.

tess: customers with explicit per-tenant caps are untouched. I'll generate release notes and DM tenants with large overrides.

omar: preflight checklist: dashboards (p95, p99, 5xx, evicts/s, inflight queue), deployer runbook, and comms.

devops-anya: canary applied to staging earlier; synthetic runs showed 10% p99 reduction on short sequences but some throughput drop on long sequences.

release-bot: [canary applied] cfg-2026-04-03-001 -> us-east1 canary at 1737010250

sre-sam: initial metrics at 5m: p95 180ms (base 170ms), p99 620ms (base 600ms), 5xx 0.01%. no alarms.

omar: propose slow ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 2.5h with manual gates. ops sign-off?

tess: agree. manual approval at each gate.

devops-anya: added probe hitting top-10 heavy routes every 20s. alert thresholds set: p99 > baseline *1.25, 5xx > 0.003.

release-bot: [rollout] staged -> 2% at 1737010600

sre-sam: alert (automated): spike in evicts/s on a subset of eu-west hosts at 1737010725, correlated with tenant Z traffic. p99 on those hosts up to 1.6s.

omar: pause ramp. set routing weight fallback for eu-west to previous config.

tess: pausing. ops-team, please hold further percentage changes.

devops-anya: investigating — tenant Z runs long sequences and high tokens/s; smaller batch_threshold is likely increasing kv churn. We can push a per-tenant override: route: tenantZ -> batch_threshold_ms=25, concurrency=64.

release-bot: [hotpatch queued] per-tenant override for tenantZ ready at 1737010860

sre-sam: after hotpatch applied, eu-west p99 returned to 680ms, 5xx normal. No further alerts.

omar: decision: do not rollback globally. keep the global conservative defaults but add per-tenant exceptions for long-seq tenants (tenantZ). Update runbook to list per-tenant override as first mitigation step.

tess: I'll update release notes to include the exception and the rollback criteria. Also adding a note: "If sustained queueing observed, quick knob: bump batch_threshold_ms to 20 for affected routes."

devops-anya: resuming ramp: continue from 2% -> 10% after 12m hold.

release-bot: [rollout] resumed -> 10% at 1737010940

sre-sam: monitoring — stable at 10% for 9m, no alerts.

omar: ok to go to 30% in 20m if green. Remember to DM core tenants that saw overrides.

product-ryan: added short note for #announcements draft: "Config-only tuning to tighten concurrency and reduce latency variance. Per-tenant exceptions applied for long-sequence workloads."

tess: thanks. tagging final: cfg-2026-04-03-001. I'll publish post-rollout summary after 30m at 100%.

release-bot: [next stage scheduled] 30% at 1737011640

sre-sam: quick reminder to ops: keep the manual gate list handy and verify synthetic probe health before each step.

omar: recorded in runbook. great work team.

tess: thanks everyone — will follow up with release notes and ticket linking.
